{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MHr2fzbB9iGxMbJ3c2GqhB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * Tenant-Permission-Guard Adoption Invariant\n3\t * ============================================================================\n4\t *\n5\t * Closes SENSOR-HIGH-022 (docs/reviews/2026-07-05-sensor-vfd-device-audit.md).\n6\t *\n7\t *   The `@RequireTenantPermission('<perm>')` decorator only enforces anything\n8\t *   when `TenantPermissionGuard` is active. The guard is opt-in (a handler\n9\t *   with no decorator passes through), so the safe wiring is a global\n10\t *   `APP_GUARD` registration in the owning service's `app.module.ts`.\n11\t *\n12\t *   Before this gate, sensor-service decorated its edge I/O-config mutations\n13\t *   with `@RequireTenantPermission('edge:manage-io-config')` but never\n14\t *   registered the guard — the fine-grained permission was dead metadata and\n15\t *   the weakest layer (the role gate) silently won.\n16\t *\n17\t * # What this spec enforces (Tier-3 \"make it detectable\")\n18\t *\n19\t *   For every `apps/<svc>` whose `src/**` uses `@RequireTenantPermission`,\n20\t *   that service's `app.module.ts` MUST register `TenantPermissionGuard` as an\n21\t *   `APP_GUARD`. Otherwise the decorator is inert.\n22\t *\n23\t * # When this spec fails\n24\t *\n25\t *   - A service added `@RequireTenantPermission` but did not wire the guard →\n26\t *     register `TenantPermissionGuard` as a fourth `APP_GUARD` (after\n27\t *     `RolesGuard`) in that service's `app.module.ts`.\n28\t */\n29\timport { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';\n30\timport path from 'node:path';\n31\t\n32\tconst REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');\n33\tconst APPS_DIR = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'apps');\n34\t\n35\t/** Recursively collect *.ts files under a directory (skips node_modules/dist). */\n36\tfunction collectTsFiles(dir: string): string[] {\n37\t  const out: string[] = [];\n38\t  if (!existsSync(dir)) return out;\n39\t  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {\n40\t    if (entry === 'node_modules' || entry === 'dist') continue;\n41\t    const full = path.join(dir, entry);\n42\t    const st = statSync(full);\n43\t    if (st.isDirectory()) {\n44\t      out.push(...collectTsFiles(full));\n45\t    } else if (entry.endsWith('.ts') && !entry.endsWith('.spec.ts')) {\n46\t      out.push(full);\n47\t    }\n48\t  }\n49\t  return out;\n50\t}\n51\t\n52\tfunction servicesUsingDecorator(): string[] {\n53\t  const services: string[] = [];\n54\t  if (!existsSync(APPS_DIR)) return services;\n55\t  for (const svc of readdirSync(APPS_DIR)) {\n56\t    const srcDir = path.join(APPS_DIR, svc, 'src');\n57\t    if (!existsSync(srcDir)) continue;\n58\t    const uses = collectTsFiles(srcDir).some((f) =>\n59\t      /@RequireTenantPermission\\s*\\(/.test(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')),\n60\t    );\n61\t    if (uses) services.push(svc);\n62\t  }\n63\t  return services;\n64\t}\n65\t\n66\tdescribe('TenantPermissionGuard adoption (SENSOR-HIGH-022)', () => {\n67\t  const services = servicesUsingDecorator();\n68\t\n69\t  it('at least one service uses @RequireTenantPermission (sanity)', () => {\n70\t    // Guards against a false-green if the decorator is ever renamed/removed.\n71\t    expect(services.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n72\t  });\n73\t\n74\t  it.each(services)(\n75\t    '%s registers TenantPermissionGuard as an APP_GUARD',\n76\t    (svc) => {\n77\t      const modulePath = path.join(APPS_DIR, svc, 'src', 'app.module.ts');\n78\t      expect(existsSync(modulePath)).toBe(true);\n79\t      const src = readFileSync(modulePath, 'utf8');\n80\t      // The guard must be both referenced and wired to the APP_GUARD token.\n81\t      expect(src).toContain('TenantPermissionGuard');\n82\t      expect(/APP_GUARD[\\s\\S]{0,400}TenantPermissionGuard/.test(src)).toBe(true);\n83\t    },\n84\t  );\n85\t});\n86\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a588792a-3120-49e1-bcd6-60f3f74a9d94","uuid":"795055d8-a642-45ea-b5ae-1cfa23cfbd9c","timestamp":"2026-09-25T09:19:24.764Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-5f04f4d6f061/tests/invariants/tenant-permission-guard-adoption.spec.ts","content":"/**\n * Tenant-Permission-Guard Adoption Invariant\n * ============================================================================\n *\n * Closes SENSOR-HIGH-022 (docs/reviews/2026-07-05-sensor-vfd-device-audit.md).\n *\n *   The `@RequireTenantPermission('<perm>')` decorator only enforces anything\n *   when `TenantPermissionGuard` is active. The guard is opt-in (a handler\n *   with no decorator passes through), so the safe wiring is a global\n *   `APP_GUARD` registration in the owning service's `app.module.ts`.\n *\n *   Before this gate, sensor-service decorated its edge I/O-config mutations\n *   with `@RequireTenantPermission('edge:manage-io-config')` but never\n *   registered the guard — the fine-grained permission was dead metadata and\n *   the weakest layer (the role gate) silently won.\n *\n * # What this spec enforces (Tier-3 \"make it detectable\")\n *\n *   For every `apps/<svc>` whose `src/**` uses `@RequireTenantPermission`,\n *   that service's `app.module.ts` MUST register `TenantPermissionGuard` as an\n *   `APP_GUARD`. Otherwise the decorator is inert.\n *\n * # When this spec fails\n *\n *   - A service added `@RequireTenantPermission` but did not wire the guard →\n *     register `TenantPermissionGuard` as a fourth `APP_GUARD` (after\n *     `RolesGuard`) in that service's `app.module.ts`.\n */\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nconst REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');\nconst APPS_DIR = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'apps');\n\n/** Recursively collect *.ts files under a directory (skips node_modules/dist). */\nfunction collectTsFiles(dir: string): string[] {\n  const out: string[] = [];\n  if (!existsSync(dir)) return out;\n  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {\n    if (entry === 'node_modules' || entry === 'dist') continue;\n    const full = path.join(dir, entry);\n    const st = statSync(full);\n    if (st.isDirectory()) {\n      out.push(...collectTsFiles(full));\n    } else if (entry.endsWith('.ts') && !entry.endsWith('.spec.ts')) {\n      out.push(full);\n    }\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\nfunction servicesUsingDecorator(): string[] {\n  const services: string[] = [];\n  if (!existsSync(APPS_DIR)) return services;\n  for (const svc of readdirSync(APPS_DIR)) {\n    const srcDir = path.join(APPS_DIR, svc, 'src');\n    if (!existsSync(srcDir)) continue;\n    const uses = collectTsFiles(srcDir).some((f) =>\n      /@RequireTenantPermission\\s*\\(/.test(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')),\n    );\n    if (uses) services.push(svc);\n  }\n  return services;\n}\n\ndescribe('TenantPermissionGuard adoption (SENSOR-HIGH-022)', () => {\n  const services = servicesUsingDecorator();\n\n  it('at least one service uses @RequireTenantPermission (sanity)', () => {\n    // Guards against a false-green if the decorator is ever renamed/removed.\n    expect(services.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n\n  it.each(services)(\n    '%s registers TenantPermissionGuard as an APP_GUARD',\n    (svc) => {\n      const modulePath = path.join(APPS_DIR, svc, 'src', 'app.module.ts');\n      expect(existsSync(modulePath)).toBe(true);\n      const src = readFileSync(modulePath, 'utf8');\n      // The guard must be both referenced and wired to the APP_GUARD token.\n      expect(src).toContain('TenantPermissionGuard');\n      expect(/APP_GUARD[\\s\\S]{0,400}TenantPermissionGuard/.test(src)).toBe(true);\n    },\n  );\n});\n","numLines":86,"startLine":1,"totalLines":86}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015woVshFzA1i2pmTKNoUiWB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * HR GraphQL FE↔BE Parity Invariant\n3\t * ============================================================================\n4\t *\n5\t * SSoT: the hr-service subgraph (NestJS resolver decorators) defines the\n6\t * GraphQL contract. Every root field the hr-module frontend requests MUST\n7\t * resolve to a backend `@Query` / `@Mutation` / `@Subscription` / `@ResolveField`\n8\t * field, or to an explicitly allowlisted cross-subgraph field served by another\n9\t * service through Apollo Federation.\n10\t *\n11\t * Why this gate exists:\n12\t *   hr-module had NO FE↔BE parity guard (only farm-module did). A hand-edited\n13\t *   root-field name (or a resolver renamed on the backend without updating the\n14\t *   FE) would render nothing in production with no build-time signal — the exact\n15\t *   failure mode the farm gate was created for. This mirrors\n16\t *   `farm-graphql-fe-be-parity.spec.ts` for the hr subgraph, consuming the same\n17\t *   shared decorator-scan SSoT (`helpers/farm-graphql-surface`) so the two gates\n18\t *   cannot drift apart.\n19\t *\n20\t * Scope: this validates ROOT operation fields (the query/mutation the FE names).\n21\t * Nested-selection / field-shape drift is covered separately by the composed-\n22\t * supergraph operation-validation gate (`scripts/ci/validate-graphql-operations`).\n23\t */\n24\timport { readFileSync } from 'fs';\n25\timport { join } from 'path';\n26\t\n27\timport { REPO_ROOT, listFiles, extractBackendFieldSet } from './helpers/farm-graphql-surface';\n28\t\n29\tconst HR_BE_SOURCE_ROOT = 'apps/hr-service/src';\n30\tconst FE_SOURCE_ROOT = 'web/modules/hr-module/src';\n31\t\n32\t/**\n33\t * Root fields hr-module legitimately requests from OTHER subgraphs via Apollo\n34\t * Federation. Every entry names the owning subgraph so the allowlist stays\n35\t * auditable; adding one requires that service to actually serve the field.\n36\t */\n37\tconst CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS: Record<string, string> = {\n38\t  // apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant.resolver.ts —\n39\t  // hr-module resolves tenant users (e.g. to attribute an approver).\n40\t  tenantUsers: 'auth-service',\n41\t};\n42\t\n43\tinterface FrontendRootField {\n44\t  operation: string;\n45\t  field: string;\n46\t  file: string;\n47\t}\n48\t\n49\t/** Extract the root field of every operation document in hr-module. */\n50\tfunction extractFrontendRootFields(): FrontendRootField[] {\n51\t  const roots: FrontendRootField[] = [];\n52\t  const re =\n53\t    /`\\s*(query|mutation|subscription)\\s+[A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\))?\\s*\\{\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g;\n54\t\n55\t  for (const file of listFiles(FE_SOURCE_ROOT, ['**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx'])) {\n56\t    if (file.includes('.spec.') || file.includes('.test.') || file.includes('test-setup')) continue;\n57\t    const src = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, file), 'utf8');\n58\t    let match: RegExpExecArray | null;\n59\t    while ((match = re.exec(src)) !== null) {\n60\t      roots.push({ operation: match[1]!, field: match[2]!, file });\n61\t    }\n62\t  }\n63\t  return roots;\n64\t}\n65\t\n66\tdescribe('hr-module ↔ hr-service GraphQL parity', () => {\n67\t  const backendFields = extractBackendFieldSet(HR_BE_SOURCE_ROOT);\n68\t  const frontendRoots = extractFrontendRootFields();\n69\t\n70\t  it('backend extraction finds a plausible resolver surface (guards against silent extractor rot)', () => {\n71\t    // hr-service serves employee/payroll/leave/scheduling/training/finance\n72\t    // fields — dozens today. A collapse of the extractor to near-zero would make\n73\t    // the parity assertion below pass vacuously.\n74\t    expect(backendFields.size).toBeGreaterThan(30);\n75\t    // Canary fields spanning domains that must always exist.\n76\t    for (const canary of ['employees', 'payrolls', 'createEmployee', 'hrLabourCost']) {\n77\t      expect(backendFields).toContain(canary);\n78\t    }\n79\t  });\n80\t\n81\t  it('frontend extraction finds a plausible operation surface', () => {\n82\t    expect(frontendRoots.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);\n83\t  });\n84\t\n85\t  it('every frontend root field resolves to an hr-service resolver or an allowlisted federation field', () => {\n86\t    const unresolved = frontendRoots.filter(\n87\t      ({ field }) => !backendFields.has(field) && !(field in CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS),\n88\t    );\n89\t\n90\t    const report = unresolved\n91\t      .map(({ operation, field, file }) => `  ${operation} { ${field} } ← ${file}`)\n92\t      .join('\\n');\n93\t\n94\t    expect(\n95\t      unresolved.length === 0\n96\t        ? ''\n97\t        : `\\n${unresolved.length} frontend operation(s) target fields the hr subgraph does not serve.\\n` +\n98\t            `Fix the field name, implement the resolver, or (for federation fields) extend CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS:\\n${report}\\n`,\n99\t    ).toBe('');\n100\t  });\n101\t});\n102\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a588792a-3120-49e1-bcd6-60f3f74a9d94","uuid":"8d6c94f8-33a3-4d6f-a8c3-ebfa1e93db68","timestamp":"2026-09-25T09:19:25.627Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-5f04f4d6f061/tests/invariants/hr-graphql-fe-be-parity.spec.ts","content":"/**\n * HR GraphQL FE↔BE Parity Invariant\n * ============================================================================\n *\n * SSoT: the hr-service subgraph (NestJS resolver decorators) defines the\n * GraphQL contract. Every root field the hr-module frontend requests MUST\n * resolve to a backend `@Query` / `@Mutation` / `@Subscription` / `@ResolveField`\n * field, or to an explicitly allowlisted cross-subgraph field served by another\n * service through Apollo Federation.\n *\n * Why this gate exists:\n *   hr-module had NO FE↔BE parity guard (only farm-module did). A hand-edited\n *   root-field name (or a resolver renamed on the backend without updating the\n *   FE) would render nothing in production with no build-time signal — the exact\n *   failure mode the farm gate was created for. This mirrors\n *   `farm-graphql-fe-be-parity.spec.ts` for the hr subgraph, consuming the same\n *   shared decorator-scan SSoT (`helpers/farm-graphql-surface`) so the two gates\n *   cannot drift apart.\n *\n * Scope: this validates ROOT operation fields (the query/mutation the FE names).\n * Nested-selection / field-shape drift is covered separately by the composed-\n * supergraph operation-validation gate (`scripts/ci/validate-graphql-operations`).\n */\nimport { readFileSync } from 'fs';\nimport { join } from 'path';\n\nimport { REPO_ROOT, listFiles, extractBackendFieldSet } from './helpers/farm-graphql-surface';\n\nconst HR_BE_SOURCE_ROOT = 'apps/hr-service/src';\nconst FE_SOURCE_ROOT = 'web/modules/hr-module/src';\n\n/**\n * Root fields hr-module legitimately requests from OTHER subgraphs via Apollo\n * Federation. Every entry names the owning subgraph so the allowlist stays\n * auditable; adding one requires that service to actually serve the field.\n */\nconst CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS: Record<string, string> = {\n  // apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant.resolver.ts —\n  // hr-module resolves tenant users (e.g. to attribute an approver).\n  tenantUsers: 'auth-service',\n};\n\ninterface FrontendRootField {\n  operation: string;\n  field: string;\n  file: string;\n}\n\n/** Extract the root field of every operation document in hr-module. */\nfunction extractFrontendRootFields(): FrontendRootField[] {\n  const roots: FrontendRootField[] = [];\n  const re =\n    /`\\s*(query|mutation|subscription)\\s+[A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\))?\\s*\\{\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g;\n\n  for (const file of listFiles(FE_SOURCE_ROOT, ['**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx'])) {\n    if (file.includes('.spec.') || file.includes('.test.') || file.includes('test-setup')) continue;\n    const src = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, file), 'utf8');\n    let match: RegExpExecArray | null;\n    while ((match = re.exec(src)) !== null) {\n      roots.push({ operation: match[1]!, field: match[2]!, file });\n    }\n  }\n  return roots;\n}\n\ndescribe('hr-module ↔ hr-service GraphQL parity', () => {\n  const backendFields = extractBackendFieldSet(HR_BE_SOURCE_ROOT);\n  const frontendRoots = extractFrontendRootFields();\n\n  it('backend extraction finds a plausible resolver surface (guards against silent extractor rot)', () => {\n    // hr-service serves employee/payroll/leave/scheduling/training/finance\n    // fields — dozens today. A collapse of the extractor to near-zero would make\n    // the parity assertion below pass vacuously.\n    expect(backendFields.size).toBeGreaterThan(30);\n    // Canary fields spanning domains that must always exist.\n    for (const canary of ['employees', 'payrolls', 'createEmployee', 'hrLabourCost']) {\n      expect(backendFields).toContain(canary);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('frontend extraction finds a plausible operation surface', () => {\n    expect(frontendRoots.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);\n  });\n\n  it('every frontend root field resolves to an hr-service resolver or an allowlisted federation field', () => {\n    const unresolved = frontendRoots.filter(\n      ({ field }) => !backendFields.has(field) && !(field in CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS),\n    );\n\n    const report = unresolved\n      .map(({ operation, field, file }) => `  ${operation} { ${field} } ← ${file}`)\n      .join('\\n');\n\n    expect(\n      unresolved.length === 0\n        ? ''\n        : `\\n${unresolved.length} frontend operation(s) target fields the hr subgraph does not serve.\\n` +\n            `Fix the field name, implement the resolver, or (for federation fields) extend CROSS_SUBGRAPH_FIELDS:\\n${report}\\n`,\n    ).toBe('');\n  });\n});\n","numLines":102,"startLine":1,"totalLines":102}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014DfP3uCTTv9bYZnXarmsjJ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * LabourCostCalculator — table-driven spec.\n3\t *\n4\t * Verifies the Labour Cost contract: annual = monthly × 12; fund lines\n5\t * are percentages of the annual salary total; total payroll = salaries\n6\t * + all funds + other cost; Money-based arithmetic rounds to 2 dp; and\n7\t * small-cell salary suppression (HR-HIGH-001) withholds per-category\n8\t * salary that would reveal an individual's pay.\n9\t */\n10\timport { LabourCostCalculator } from '../services/labour-cost-calculator.service';\n11\timport { LaborCategory } from '../../hr/entities/employee.entity';\n12\t\n13\tdescribe('LabourCostCalculator', () => {\n14\t  const calculator = new LabourCostCalculator();\n15\t\n16\t  it('annualises monthly salaries (× 12) per category', () => {\n17\t    const result = calculator.compute(\n18\t      [\n19\t        { category: LaborCategory.MANAGER, headcount: 3, monthlySalaryTotal: 30000 },\n20\t        { category: LaborCategory.TECHNICAL, headcount: 3, monthlySalaryTotal: 15000 },\n21\t        { category: LaborCategory.UNSKILLED, headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 10000 },\n22\t      ],\n23\t      { pensionFundPct: 0, socialInsurancePct: 0, medicalInsurancePct: 0, otherCostPct: 0 },\n24\t      'NOK',\n25\t    );\n26\t\n27\t    const manager = result.rows.find((r) => r.category === LaborCategory.MANAGER);\n28\t    expect(manager?.salarySuppressed).toBe(false);\n29\t    expect(manager?.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(360000); // 30000 × 12\n30\t    expect(manager?.avgAnnualSalary).toBe(120000); // 360000 / 3 headcount\n31\t    expect(result.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(660000); // (30000+15000+10000) × 12\n32\t    expect(result.totalHeadcount).toBe(11);\n33\t  });\n34\t\n35\t  it('computes each fund as a percentage of the annual salary total', () => {\n36\t    const result = calculator.compute(\n37\t      [{ category: LaborCategory.MANAGER, headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 10000 }],\n38\t      {\n39\t        pensionFundPct: 11,\n40\t        socialInsurancePct: 9.5,\n41\t        medicalInsurancePct: 7.5,\n42\t        otherCostPct: 5,\n43\t      },\n44\t      'NOK',\n45\t    );\n46\t\n47\t    // Annual = 10000 × 12 = 120000\n48\t    expect(result.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(120000);\n49\t    expect(result.pensionFund).toBe(13200); // 11%\n50\t    expect(result.socialInsuranceFund).toBe(11400); // 9.5%\n51\t    expect(result.medicalInsuranceFund).toBe(9000); // 7.5%\n52\t    expect(result.otherCost).toBe(6000); // 5%\n53\t    // Total = 120000 + 13200 + 11400 + 9000 + 6000\n54\t    expect(result.totalPayroll).toBe(159600);\n55\t  });\n56\t\n57\t  it('defaults all funds to zero when rates are zero (product default)', () => {\n58\t    const result = calculator.compute(\n59\t      [{ category: LaborCategory.TECHNICAL, headcount: 4, monthlySalaryTotal: 5000 }],\n60\t      { pensionFundPct: 0, socialInsurancePct: 0, medicalInsurancePct: 0, otherCostPct: 5 },"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a588792a-3120-49e1-bcd6-60f3f74a9d94","uuid":"825f4b66-fbbf-4756-8b4b-ef98376fec37","timestamp":"2026-09-25T09:20:24.180Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-5f04f4d6f061/apps/hr-service/src/finance/__tests__/labour-cost-calculator.spec.ts","content":"/**\n * LabourCostCalculator — table-driven spec.\n *\n * Verifies the Labour Cost contract: annual = monthly × 12; fund lines\n * are percentages of the annual salary total; total payroll = salaries\n * + all funds + other cost; Money-based arithmetic rounds to 2 dp; and\n * small-cell salary suppression (HR-HIGH-001) withholds per-category\n * salary that would reveal an individual's pay.\n */\nimport { LabourCostCalculator } from '../services/labour-cost-calculator.service';\nimport { LaborCategory } from '../../hr/entities/employee.entity';\n\ndescribe('LabourCostCalculator', () => {\n  const calculator = new LabourCostCalculator();\n\n  it('annualises monthly salaries (× 12) per category', () => {\n    const result = calculator.compute(\n      [\n        { category: LaborCategory.MANAGER, headcount: 3, monthlySalaryTotal: 30000 },\n        { category: LaborCategory.TECHNICAL, headcount: 3, monthlySalaryTotal: 15000 },\n        { category: LaborCategory.UNSKILLED, headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 10000 },\n      ],\n      { pensionFundPct: 0, socialInsurancePct: 0, medicalInsurancePct: 0, otherCostPct: 0 },\n      'NOK',\n    );\n\n    const manager = result.rows.find((r) => r.category === LaborCategory.MANAGER);\n    expect(manager?.salarySuppressed).toBe(false);\n    expect(manager?.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(360000); // 30000 × 12\n    expect(manager?.avgAnnualSalary).toBe(120000); // 360000 / 3 headcount\n    expect(result.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(660000); // (30000+15000+10000) × 12\n    expect(result.totalHeadcount).toBe(11);\n  });\n\n  it('computes each fund as a percentage of the annual salary total', () => {\n    const result = calculator.compute(\n      [{ category: LaborCategory.MANAGER, headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 10000 }],\n      {\n        pensionFundPct: 11,\n        socialInsurancePct: 9.5,\n        medicalInsurancePct: 7.5,\n        otherCostPct: 5,\n      },\n      'NOK',\n    );\n\n    // Annual = 10000 × 12 = 120000\n    expect(result.annualSalaryTotal).toBe(120000);\n    expect(result.pensionFund).toBe(13200); // 11%\n    expect(result.socialInsuranceFund).toBe(11400); // 9.5%\n    expect(result.medicalInsuranceFund).toBe(9000); // 7.5%\n    expect(result.otherCost).toBe(6000); // 5%\n    // Total = 120000 + 13200 + 11400 + 9000 + 6000\n    expect(result.totalPayroll).toBe(159600);\n  });\n\n  it('defaults all funds to zero when rates are zero (product default)', () => {\n    const result = calculator.compute(\n      [{ category: LaborCategory.TECHNICAL, headcount: 4, monthlySalaryTotal: 5000 }],\n      { pensionFundPct: 0, socialInsurancePct: 0, medicalInsurancePct: 0, otherCostPct: 5 },","numLines":60,"startLine":1,"totalLines":178}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01645K7W3GoHPqemJ9F5fvbh","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * mergeDepartmentCosts — pure per-department salary/expense merge.\n3\t *\n4\t * Guards the HR-HIGH-002 fix: a manual expense must be attributed to exactly\n5\t * one department, an unassigned (null-departmentHrId) expense pool must not\n6\t * fan out across multiple rows, an expense-only department must not be dropped,\n7\t * and small department salaries are suppressed (HR-HIGH-001).\n8\t */\n9\timport { mergeDepartmentCosts } from '../query-handlers/get-hr-finance-summary.handler';\n10\t\n11\tdescribe('mergeDepartmentCosts', () => {\n12\t  it('attributes an unassigned expense pool to a SINGLE Unassigned row, not each null-FK row', () => {\n13\t    // Two enum-department groups both had a null departmentHrId in the buggy\n14\t    // version. Now the employee side is pre-grouped by departmentHrId, so there\n15\t    // is exactly one null (\"Unassigned\") salary row.\n16\t    const result = mergeDepartmentCosts(\n17\t      [\n18\t        { departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 25000 },\n19\t        { departmentHrId: null, departmentName: 'Unassigned', headcount: 4, monthlySalaryTotal: 16000 },\n20\t      ],\n21\t      [\n22\t        // The whole unassigned-expense pool, under the single null key.\n23\t        { departmentHrId: null, departmentName: 'Unassigned', total: 9000 },\n24\t      ],\n25\t    );\n26\t\n27\t    const unassigned = result.filter((r) => r.departmentHrId === null);\n28\t    expect(unassigned).toHaveLength(1);\n29\t    expect(unassigned[0]?.hrExpenses).toBe(9000); // attributed exactly once\n30\t    // The named department gets none of the unassigned pool.\n31\t    expect(result.find((r) => r.departmentHrId === 'd1')?.hrExpenses).toBe(0);\n32\t    // Total expenses across all rows equals the input (no double-count).\n33\t    expect(result.reduce((s, r) => s + r.hrExpenses, 0)).toBe(9000);\n34\t  });\n35\t\n36\t  it('surfaces an expense-only department (no active employees) as its own row', () => {\n37\t    const result = mergeDepartmentCosts(\n38\t      [{ departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 25000 }],\n39\t      [\n40\t        { departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', total: 1000 },"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a588792a-3120-49e1-bcd6-60f3f74a9d94","uuid":"9ef1588d-adf5-42c1-8b49-c7b16cda31f0","timestamp":"2026-09-25T09:20:25.308Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-5f04f4d6f061/apps/hr-service/src/finance/__tests__/merge-department-costs.spec.ts","content":"/**\n * mergeDepartmentCosts — pure per-department salary/expense merge.\n *\n * Guards the HR-HIGH-002 fix: a manual expense must be attributed to exactly\n * one department, an unassigned (null-departmentHrId) expense pool must not\n * fan out across multiple rows, an expense-only department must not be dropped,\n * and small department salaries are suppressed (HR-HIGH-001).\n */\nimport { mergeDepartmentCosts } from '../query-handlers/get-hr-finance-summary.handler';\n\ndescribe('mergeDepartmentCosts', () => {\n  it('attributes an unassigned expense pool to a SINGLE Unassigned row, not each null-FK row', () => {\n    // Two enum-department groups both had a null departmentHrId in the buggy\n    // version. Now the employee side is pre-grouped by departmentHrId, so there\n    // is exactly one null (\"Unassigned\") salary row.\n    const result = mergeDepartmentCosts(\n      [\n        { departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 25000 },\n        { departmentHrId: null, departmentName: 'Unassigned', headcount: 4, monthlySalaryTotal: 16000 },\n      ],\n      [\n        // The whole unassigned-expense pool, under the single null key.\n        { departmentHrId: null, departmentName: 'Unassigned', total: 9000 },\n      ],\n    );\n\n    const unassigned = result.filter((r) => r.departmentHrId === null);\n    expect(unassigned).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(unassigned[0]?.hrExpenses).toBe(9000); // attributed exactly once\n    // The named department gets none of the unassigned pool.\n    expect(result.find((r) => r.departmentHrId === 'd1')?.hrExpenses).toBe(0);\n    // Total expenses across all rows equals the input (no double-count).\n    expect(result.reduce((s, r) => s + r.hrExpenses, 0)).toBe(9000);\n  });\n\n  it('surfaces an expense-only department (no active employees) as its own row', () => {\n    const result = mergeDepartmentCosts(\n      [{ departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', headcount: 5, monthlySalaryTotal: 25000 }],\n      [\n        { departmentHrId: 'd1', departmentName: 'Operations', total: 1000 },","numLines":40,"startLine":1,"totalLines":118}}}

When two judges agree, the kernel is about to convert their agreement into repository ground truth: the finding class gets suppressed, the rule can be quarantined, and both judges get scored on it. A third voice that simply echoes them adds no information while adding the authority of a third signature — that is the specific failure this mode is built to prevent. So the work is to re-derive the verdict from the repository and try to break it. Concretely: read the adapter to learn what the rule actually asserts (two conjuncts — security-sensitive source, and no adjacent or importing test), confirm the first against the file, then attack the second by hunting for any test that covers it. The attack has to be made against the rule's own matching definition and against the substance, because those can diverge: a test can cover behaviour while failing the matcher, which would make the finding mechanically right and substantively wrong. Here they do not diverge. The nearest tests are pure-function specs, and the two invariant specs assert module wiring and field-name existence, so they would stay green through a regression that widened @Roles at hr-finance.resolver.ts:271, dropped @RequireTenantPermission at :121, or forced includeSalary true at :148. If this step were skipped, the downstream effect would be a suppressed finding class over a live, frontend-reachable authorisation surface (hr-finance.module.ts:41, finance.operations.ts:4) and two judge scores raised on an unaudited agreement.
